diagnosis: The proxy forwards requests to an internal storage microservice to obtain presigned download URLs for docId. It authenticates the user, but never validates whether the user has read permissions on docId before proxying. Any authenticated user can download confidential contracts, medical records, or tax documents belonging to any user.
exploit_request:
GET /docs/doc_tax_return_2025_confidential/download HTTP/1.1
Host: storage.enterprise.io
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
